description: Video file, YouTube or Vimeo link behind a cover with a play button; nothing from the platform loads before the click.

howToUse: Pass a video file or a YouTube or Vimeo address in `src`; the component detects which one.
YouTube opens on the cookie-free domain and Vimeo with do-not-track. Without `poster`, YouTube uses the video's own thumbnail.
For video files, add WebVTT `captions` whenever there is speech.

keyboard.action: Starts the video; the player controls take over from there.

props.name: captions
props.type: { src: string; srcLang: string; label: string; default?: boolean | undefined; }[] | undefined
props.description: Captions for the video file (WebVTT). Not used for YouTube and Vimeo, which bring their own.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element.
